request_body.raw_goal: Train for a half-marathon. Race is in 10 weeks. I have a training plan — I need the system to help me track execution and not fall behind.
request_body.user_context: Senior PM, structured and disciplined. Regular early morning schedule. Wants the system to help reason across goals, not just list tasks.

objectives: Execute the 10-week half-marathon training block with high adherence to prescribed pace and volume.
Develop physiological aerobic capacity to sustain goal race pace for 13.1 miles.
Implement systematic recovery and injury prevention protocols to manage load.
Integrate running data (HRV, RPE, and splits) to inform real-time training adjustments.

proposed_milestones.description: Establish baseline running mechanics and integrate training logging cadence into early morning routine.
objectives: Log initial resting heart rate and perceived exertion levels for the first two weeks of base building.
Verify alignment between training plan mileage and weekly schedule capacity.
Perform a functional movement screening or gait analysis to identify potential injury vectors.

proposed_milestones.description: Progress through the aerobic base phase, incorporating consistent threshold intervals and structural volume.
objectives: Execute prescribed tempo runs at lactate threshold pace to improve anaerobic buffering capacity.
Maintain strict adherence to easy-run intensity zones to ensure cardiovascular adaptation without overreaching.
Review weekly training delta against the plan to identify and mitigate missed sessions.

proposed_milestones.description: Execute peak volume microcycles and optimize metabolic efficiency for race-day performance.
objectives: Complete peak long-run mileage to build muscular endurance and glycogen utilization capacity.
Simulate race-day fueling and hydration strategy during high-intensity long efforts.
Synthesize performance data from peak weeks to refine race-day pacing strategy.

proposed_milestones.description: Implement the pre-race taper protocol to optimize physiological recovery while maintaining neuromuscular sharpness.
objectives: Reduce total volume per the training plan while maintaining short bursts of race-pace intensity.
Finalize race-day gear selection and logistics based on training performance data.
Conduct a full review of training logs to confirm readiness and identify optimal pace targets.

success_metrics: Completion of 90% or more of the prescribed training plan sessions.
Ability to sustain target race heart rate and pace for a 10-mile training effort without performance degradation.
Absence of injury symptoms requiring plan interruption during the final 3-week taper.
Successful completion of the 13.1-mile race within 3% of the projected goal time.
